children: *Pony AI 3Q Robotaxi Services Rev Rose 165% on Year to $17.8M>PONY
*Pony AI Robotaxi Fleet Reached 2,768 Vehicles as of End-September >PONY
Pony AI Loss Widens, Robotaxi Revenue Surges
Pony AI's net loss widened even as revenue surged in the third quarter as the Chinese autonomous-driving company rapidly scaled up its fleet size and expanded operations abroad.
Net loss attributable to Pony AI was $105.6 million, widening from $61.3 million a year ago. Revenue climbed 76% to $44.6 million.

The Nasdaq-listed company, one of China's big three robotaxi operators, reported a surge in robotaxi services revenue, which more than doubled to $17.8 million. The robotaxi business accounted for a record 40% of total revenue for the third quarter.
Revenue from robotruck services rose 76% to $18.0 million, while that from the intelligent solutions business rose 3.4% to $8.9 million.
Its gross margin was 17.8%, down from 18.4% a year ago but higher than 17.5% in the second quarter.

"We remain on track to achieve our 2026 targets: expanding our robotaxi fleet to 3,500 vehicles deployed in 20 cities worldwide by year-end, while growing full-year robotaxi services revenues to 3.5 times the 2025 level," Chief Financial Officer Leo Wang said.
Pony AI's robotaxi fleet reached 2,768 vehicles at the end of September.

The company has been rapidly expanding in overseas markets while gradually building its fleet. In October, it partnered with ride-hailing platform inDrive and Nvidia to launch robotaxi services in Kazakhstan, marking its foray into Central Asia.

Morgan Stanley estimates that robotaxis will account for 1% of China's combined taxi and ride-hailing fleet by 2028, or roughly 46,000 vehicles, according to a recent note. It initiated coverage on Pony AI with an overweight rating and a target price of $10.00, adding that early movers are well positioned to capture a disproportionate share of emerging demand.
Shares of Pony AI are down by more than 70% this year.
